name: IREN Limited
sector: Data centers / AI cloud (neocloud) — screener classifies as Finance (sector misfit)
moat_justification: Secured power portfolio and vertical integration are a genuine, hard-to-replicate head start validated by hyperscaler contracts, but the measured economics show no moat yet: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json was +0.06% (FY2022), −52.19% (FY2023), −3.11% (FY2024), +0.73% (FY2025), −14.06% (FY2026) — never sustainably above the cost of capital — and gross margin of 68.9% in FY2026 is before the D&A and impairment charges that define a GPU-rental asset base. GPU cloud is near-commodity, Microsoft alone is about half the contracted 2026 run-rate, and the model consumes external capital continuously (FY2027 capex guided $25–30B).
fragility_flags: DILUTION: share count growing 79.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
one_liner: Bitcoin-to-AI-cloud pivot with a scarce secured-power portfolio and real hyperscaler contracts (Microsoft $9.7B, NVIDIA $3.4B), moat 4/10, but owner's earnings are negative in all 5 of the last 5 years (normalized -$1.66/sh), FY2027 capex is guided at $25-30B, and the share count grows 79.3%/yr — no positive price clears the 15% hurdle until it prints a positive-OE year.
moat_for: Secured power at scale: 810 MW operational, 2,100 MW under construction, 1,600 MW in development, >4.5 GW secured — grid interconnection is the binding AI constraint and takes years to replicate
Vertically integrated: owns land, data centers and operations; no data centers pledged as collateral
Blue-chip contracted demand: Microsoft $9.7B/5yr, NVIDIA ~$3.4B/5yr, Anthropic multi-year, with customer prepayments covering a large share of GPU capex
Renewable, low-cost power heritage from the mining era
moat_against: GPU cloud is near-commodity — customers Microsoft/NVIDIA are also the best-capitalized potential competitors and set renewal pricing
Customer concentration: Microsoft ~$1.94B/yr of the $4B contracted 2026 run-rate; most of the rest non-investment-grade AI developers
Contracts run ~3–5 years vs GPUs depreciated over five — years 4–5 obsolescence economics sit with IREN
ROIC negative through the cycle (roic_proxy FY2026 −14.06%, FY2025 +0.73%) and continuous external-capital dependence: FY2027 capex guided $25–30B vs ~$14B committed
Bitcoin still ~81.8% of FY2026 revenue — the cash engine being dismantled is crypto-price exposed
